title: Context-Aware Subtitle Translation on CPU: Deployment-Driven Training, Evaluation, and Latency Design
abstract: arXiv:2607.09957v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study English-to-Traditional-Chinese (Taiwan) subtitle translation for a free browser extension, where the model must run on the viewer's CPU in about 500 ms per subtitle. We train two models built on the LMT-60 base models, Sotto-1.7B and the deployed Sotto-0.6B, with a task-specific vocabulary, continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, weight interpolation, logit distillation and on-policy preference optimization. Because reference translations of subtitles are unreliable, we evaluate by pairwise comparison against one fixed baseline, Google Translate, with each pair judged in both orders by a panel of two LLM judges. On 1,820 held-out subtitles, Sotto-1.7B has a win rate of 0.576 against the baseline and wins head-to-head against four open translation models, and is slightly below a 27B model. translated_title: CPU上的上下文感知字幕翻译：以部署为导向的训练、评估与延迟设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究面向免费浏览器扩展的英语到繁体中文（台湾）字幕翻译，模型必须在观看者的CPU上运行，每条字幕的处理时间约为500毫秒。我们基于LMT-60基础模型训练了两个模型：Sotto-1.7B和已部署的Sotto-0.6B，采用了任务专用词表、持续预训练、监督微调、权重插值、logit蒸馏以及在线策略偏好优化等技术。由于字幕的参考译文不可靠，我们通过与固定基线Google Translate的成对比较进行评估，每对译文由两个LLM评审组成的评审团以两种顺序分别评判。在1,820条保留测试字幕上，Sotto-1.7B对基线的胜率为0.576，并在正面对比中胜过四个开源翻译模型，表现略低于一个27B模型。我们将延迟划分为预填充和解码两个阶段：空闲时间预填充，即在等待新字幕到来的同时预先填充提示词中已知的部分……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了可在观众CPU上以每条约500毫秒完成翻译的英译繁体中文字幕模型，通过部署驱动的训练流程、基于LLM评审的成对比较评估方法以及空闲时间预填充等延迟优化设计，实现了高质量翻译与严格延迟约束的兼顾。
en_tdlr: This paper trains English-to-Traditional-Chinese subtitle translation models that run on viewer CPUs within a ~500 ms budget per subtitle, combining deployment-driven training, LLM-judged pairwise evaluation against Google Translate, and latency optimizations such as idle-time prefill.
